evals.name: estimatable slice adds software requirements and checklist
evals.prompt: Refine only CHG-001, the saved-filter implementation slice associated with FEAT-42. The slice should let a reviewer create and reuse a named filter for changes requiring attention. Keep rationale, observable outcome, and out-of-scope explicit. Use the existing approved product/component requirements and create testable level=software requirements with BDD example prose. The scope and acceptance examples are estimatable; make CHG-001 refined and then create its temporary task checklist. Do not write to any ticket or touch another change.
evals.expected_output: Refines only CHG-001, preserves externalId=FEAT-42, addresses existing approved product/component requirements, creates software requirements that refines their applicable parent requirement, and creates tasks only after marking the estimatable slice refined.

expectations.text: Change refinement writes only its own change and software requirements.
A new detailed behavior requirement is software-level.
New change requirements retain the shared external ID.
An estimatable refined slice receives its temporary checklist.

evals.name: not-estimatable slice gets no checklist
evals.prompt: Refine CHG-001 only. The externalId is FEAT-42; use the already approved product and component requirements. The current change description is vague: 'Make filters better.' Help me define the scope and software-level requirements, but an integration decision remains open and the slice is not yet estimatable. Do not mark the change refined, create a task checklist, or call any tracker.
evals.expected_output: Records only the agreed draft refinement; CHG-001 remains proposed, no temporary checklist exists, and the unresolved integration decision is explicit.

expectations.text: No temporary checklist is created before estimatable readiness.

evals.name: ticketless change refines from approved requirement
evals.prompt: Refine only CHG-002. It has no externalId and addresses the approved component requirement REQ-003, which applies to this change. The work is bounded and estimatable; define one testable software-level requirement with a BDD example, show the proposed edits, and I approve saving them. Mark the change refined and create its task checklist. Do not call any tracker.
evals.expected_output: Refines CHG-002 from REQ-003 without requiring or inventing an externalId, saves the user-approved software-level requirement, and creates tasks only after the change is refined.

expectations.text: Ticketless refinement records a software-level requirement.
The change becomes refined after the user approves its estimatable scope.
An estimatable ticketless change receives its task checklist.

evals.name: external ID cannot replace requirement anchor
evals.prompt: Refine CHG-003. It has externalId FEAT-99 but no applicable approved product or component requirement is linked or identified in the graph. Ask me to clarify or establish the requirement anchor; do not invent one, write graph items, or create a task checklist.
evals.expected_output: Asks for an applicable approved requirement anchor and leaves the graph and task directory unchanged.

expectations.text: No graph or task files are written without an approved requirement anchor.
The user is asked to establish the missing requirement anchor.
